input: Exact standing C lattice plus epsilon masses at diag(a)Z^5+z, with z in the fundamental cell; cell mass1+epsilon. Primary length family1..4 in every coordinate. Satellite capture is the full actual satellite count at each limiting primary radius.
mechanism: Analytic exposed-boundary insertion kernel, not finite-epsilon differences; derive full displacement cell structure and certify one non-half-period displacement event interval.
full_kernel: Sum over exposed original witness facets of max competing common-radius speeds n_sat*r/(5N), removing facets already covered on the outward side. Add isolated satellite halo's exterior local volume fraction. Subtract the exact C for denominator derivative.
registered_slice: z=(0,t,0,0,0), 0<t<a2/2. Locate the complete raw-endpoint arrangement interval containing a2/4. Use exactly three internal affine nodes theta=1/4,1/2,3/4 of that interval. No other positions or epsilon grid.
event_hyperplanes: For each coordinate, raw primary box endpoints e and limiting radii r, include z_j=e, z_j=e+r-a_j*k and z_j=e-r-a_j*k, including reflected signs modulo periods. Integer k range-4..4 is sufficient for all recorded limiting radii<=2. Event arrangement over-approximates all combinatorial changes.
cell_claim: Within an open full displacement cell the exposed-face term is multiaffine in z, of total degree<=4. Along the selected one-coordinate slice it is affine. Three exact interior values recover endpoint limits and independently check affine identity; negative limiting endpoint values certify the open interval only.
normalization: Full numerator boundary derivative B(z); normalized derivative D(z)=B(z)+isolated_halo_fraction(z)-C. For the one-tail slice, sum the two reflected halfcell kernels and multiply by16. The selected interval must lie strictly inside the baseline unit-atom halo, otherwise isolate-halo contribution must be handled before execution.
limits: 120 seconds and200000 recursive union nodes per reflected-halfcell evaluation; at most6 evaluations for the3 positions. One independent exact mixed-box jet check at the middle position only; no external audit claim.
acceptance: Strict positive D triggers immediate lock and parent review; strict negative endpoint limits yield only a delimited finite-witness local obstruction. Never promote finite-family failure to an upper bound on the full periodic maximal function or C5.
